A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GimbalDiffusion, with readable and directly matchable text, equations, tables and figures. Both end with references on page 19; neither contains an appendix. Separately referenced supplementary material is not included in the supplied PDFs.

before.justification: v3 reports original SpatialVID-extreme experiments and ablations in Table 1, plus PolyHaven prompt-camera entanglement experiments in Figure 6.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments, with revised numerical results in Table 1 and updated qualitative and quantitative results in Figure 6.

M1.justification: The gravity-aligned pose pipeline, camera encodings, trajectory sampling, null-pitch captioning and look-down negative prompting remain unchanged. Updated results do not establish a change to the method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain PanoVid training, SpatialVID-extreme camera-control evaluation and PolyHaven prompt-camera entanglement evaluation. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains PreciseCam+GEN3C, both AC3D variants, PreciseCam+WAN-I2V-CC and UCPE. Figure 6 also retains the same comparator set.

E3.justification: The reported training configurations, 138-video SpatialVID-extreme benchmark, evaluation metrics and 380 prompt/pitch cases remain unchanged. Neither PDF documents a protocol change explaining the revised outputs.

E4.justification: Figure 6 revises the existing entanglement case study by replacing the proposed method's and no-null-pitch variant's examples at all three illustrated pitch angles and updating their curves. The analysis question and null-pitch/absolute-rotation ablation factors remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. Figure 6 retains the same scatter-and-curve reporting format; changed plotted values do not introduce a new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises the CogVideoX 'Ours' row and all three GimbalDiffusion UCPE rows. For example, CogVideoX PitchErr changes from 21.19 to 19.67, while default UCPE PitchErr changes from 13.98 to 13.95 and FVD from 978.1 to 997.9. Ablation summaries change from 3.62x/3.27x to 3.67x/3.36x and from 35% to 37%. Figure 6 replaces six qualitative examples and updates method/ablation curves without changing the principal findings.

T1.justification: The camera representations, gravity-alignment equations and mathematical content of Algorithm 1 are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same contributions: gravity-aware camera control, panoramic training-data generation, null-pitch conditioning and two evaluation benchmarks. Numerical updates do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of prompt-camera conflict and the benefits of absolute rotations remain unchanged. The discussion retains the same limitations concerning source-video translations and visual artifacts; revised ablation ratios change magnitude rather than interpretation.

D1.justification: Data filtering, captioning models, sampling details, backbone configurations, the project link and promised dataset release are unchanged. No additional implementation or reproducibility information accompanies the revised results.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 56 references are unchanged, including the positioning relative to UCPE, camera-control methods and panoramic video generation.

P1.justification: Small textual edits update the arXiv version/date stamp and standardize 'null-pitch' hyphenation in Figure 6. The narrative, section ordering and explanatory prose remain unchanged apart from numerical summaries.

P2.justification: Figure 6 resizes the qualitative montage, wraps headings and prompt text differently, changes plot colors and redraws the updated results. Figures 1-5, the table structure and the overall document layout remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The Table 1 and Figure 6 updates preserve the same main findings under unchanged documented protocols. Both versions provide internally consistent ablation summaries, and v4 adds no new validation, reproducibility information or uncertainty analysis. The limited presentation edits and mixed numerical shifts do not materially improve or weaken the paper's overall quality.
